name: Ratio Call Write
summary: Long 100 shares plus 2 short calls; one call is covered by the shares and the second is naked, creating unlimited upside risk.

legs.strike_rule: call delta 0.30-0.40, one covered by shares and one UNCOVERED

when_to_use: COMPLETENESS / MOSTLY HISTORICAL: a floor-trader-era structure for very high IV on a stock expected to stall. The second short call is naked, so it requires level 4 and has unlimited risk. Under Level 3 the correct expression is a covered call plus a call credit spread.
max_profit: total call credit + (strike - share cost basis) x 100, at the strike
breakevens: lower = share cost basis - credit/100; upper = strike + [(strike - cost basis) + credit/100]

greeks.delta: near zero at entry by construction (100 share deltas minus roughly 70 option deltas)

entry_rules: BLOCKED AT LEVEL 3: the second short call is uncovered, requiring Alpaca level 4. The router must reject this slug.
Level 4 version: IV rank >= 70, strike delta 0.30-0.40, and a hard buy-stop in the shares above the upper breakeven.
Level-3 substitute: covered call on the 100 shares plus a separate defined-risk call credit spread.
management_rules: Level 4 only: close at 50% of total credit.
Level 4 only: close immediately if spot exceeds the short strike, and always close at 21 DTE.
exit_rules: ASSIGNMENT GUARD: 2 short calls, 1 uncovered; close both by 15:45 ET on expiration day, unconditionally.
ASSIGNMENT GUARD: close immediately if the short calls are ITM with extrinsic < $0.10.
DIVIDEND GUARD: close before every ex-dividend date when the short calls are ITM.
assignment_risk: Assignment on both calls delivers -200 shares; only 100 are covered by the held position, leaving a naked 100-share short with unlimited exposure.
buying_power: Share position plus naked short call margin on the uncovered contract.
common_mistakes: Believing that holding shares makes both calls 'covered'; running it into a takeover or a squeeze.
family: three-leg-structures (butterflies, broken-wing butterflies, lizards, three-strike ratio spreads, ladders/tree spreads, christmas trees, and three-leg stock+option hybrids)
blocked_because: needs Alpaca options level 4; this account is level 3. Alpaca rejects it with 'account not eligible to trade uncovered option contracts'. Raising the level is an Alpaca approval, not a code change.
